transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Lucy. How can I assist you today?
Customer: I am really frustrated because my current bill is way too high and I need to change my plan immediately.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are feeling frustrated with your current billing, I would be happy to look into this for you. Could you please provide your account number and date of birth for verification?
Customer: My account number is 97853442 and my date of birth is 21/02/1967. My name is Sneha Khan and I live at 100 Linking Road.
Agent: Thank you for verifying those details, Sneha. I see your current plan details here. I can switch you to our Value Plan which is 45 dollars per month, and this change will take effect on the first of next month.
Customer: That sounds much better than what I am paying now. Will that definitely lower my bill?
Agent: Yes, based on your usage, this plan is designed to be more cost-effective for you. I will now process the plan change and send a confirmation SMS to 93185 40283 once it is complete.
Customer: That is perfect, thank you so much for your help.
Agent: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today? To summarize, I have processed your plan change to the Value Plan starting next month and you will receive a confirmation text shortly. Thank you for choosing Nimbus Telecom, have a great day.
